results.title: Please, Don’t Cry
results.overview: A professional mourner goes to what seems just another job when she begins to suspect that the deceased might be tied to her forgotten past.

results.title: My Love Story with Yamada-kun at Lv999
results.original_title: 山田くんとLv999の恋をする
results.overview: Akane Kinoshita is a university student, who was recently dumped by her ex-boyfriend. She is still heart broken by the rejection. She meets high school student & professional gamer Akito Yamada through an online game. At first, she thinks he is blunt and cold to people, but he sometimes shows his gentler side with her, like putting a band-aid on her wound or carrying her on his back when she gets drunk. Due to this, she gradually becomes attracted to him ... but Akito Yamada has zero interest in romance.

results.title: Amusement Park
results.overview: Anonymous figures pass through the gates of a park at night, seeking adventure in its dark alleys. An amusement park is ruled by the laws of desire.

results.title: Worn Out
results.overview: As a teenager, Warti carried too much burden: being a mother, the backbone of the family, as well as a victim in her own household. She tried to breastfeed her baby, but stress and malnutrition prevented her from producing milk. Meanwhile, her husband, Supri, is immersed in online gambling and violence. From behind a pile of false eyelashes that she strings together to survive, Warti searches for the strength to make a decision: stay in the toxic household, or leave for a better life for herself and her baby.

results.title: Bartogay Lake
results.overview: An old man crosses the boundless Kazakh steppe, driving alone. Haunted by memories of a lost love, he stops by Bartogay Lake, flowers in hand. But as he tries to step out, his car door refuses to open, trapping him between past and present.

results.title: Children in the Fire
results.overview: This movie celebrates the human spirit. Ukrainian children's resilience, strength, and ability to overcome tragedies and losses make each story a great inspiration for everyone. They had the strength to overcome the darkest moments that today's war brought upon them and win this war with dignity. These little heroes can, through their stories, inspire others.

results.title: WWE Elimination Chamber 2025 Post Show
results.overview: WWE Superstars and analysts examine the fallout from WWE Elimination Chamber 2025.

results.title: Breed of Greed
results.overview: The death of a patriarch leads to a scramble for power among his family, leading to some deadly actions.

results.title: Nanticoke
results.overview: An up-and-coming baseball star, Brad Chase suffers a significant injury, which ends his career. He finds himself returning home to his small Pennsylvania town to be honored. Brad soon realizes his hometown has a deep, dark secret that must be revealed to save the town from a military experiment that went wrong.

results.title: The Littles
results.overview: When 11 year old Juliet stubs her toe on a loose floorboard, she unwittingly sets off a series of mysterious events. A faint noise and an unusual glow seeping through the cracks capture her curiosity. But as she investigates, Juliet finds herself pulled into a chilling, otherworldly encounter.

results.title: Bobo in Bliss
results.overview: Bowen, a Singaporean teenager studying in an American boarding school is visited by her traditional parents and younger sister. While the visit includes the anticipated Annual Fall Dinner at her boarding school, it is evident that they may not have left on the best of terms; the tension is piercing. The dramatic central question: is Bowen able to reconcile the differences between their values and her affirming self-discoveries.

results.title: Milagro
results.overview: A group of strangers trapped in a storm shelter during a hurricane have to decide if they should put a mortally injured man out of his misery or wait for rescue to come.

results.title: Viper
results.overview: A trio of covert operatives in an elite group of assassins-for-hire are bound by the strictest code of conduct: no romantic entanglements.

results.title: Existence Is a Coincidence
results.overview: An absurd day in the life of a student in Belgrade, Serbia.

results.title: Festivalnation
results.overview: A vibrant documentary exploring Hungary's iconic summer festivals - Sziget, VOLT, Balaton Sound, Kapolcs and more - through music, memories, and the untold stories behind a freedom out of dust.

results.title: Land of Cold
results.overview: Immigrants from Sub-Saharan Africa have chosen to start their lives over north of the 49th parallel. Here, in the vast expanses of Northern Canada, they reflect on the challenges and splendors of a season they’ve never yet experienced: winter.

results.title: Trick
results.overview: Yesterday’s impossible dreams of children in a poor region of Iran have now become their goals today, after 10 years, thanks to the efforts of a wrestling coach.

results.title: Death Red
results.overview: Outlawed in 1984, the paint known as "Death Red" was found to contain a serial killer's victims. Legend warns that using it and uttering the phrase "open their eyes" awakens the souls within. Now, a young artist dares to use it for her magnum opus.

results.title: Java Jive
results.overview: A thirsty young man tries to resist a hot drink.

results.title: Camera X
results.overview: After children go missing in a rural town, a small group decides to seek vengeance. With the help of a college film student they document their journey to justice. All are willing to do jail time to protect the children.
